note: Series trimmed to 1900 onward. Citations name the underlying producer via Our World in Data and come from each grapher's metadata endpoint.

owid.vdem.electdem.label: Electoral democracy index
owid.vdem.electdem.subtitle: Data by V-Dem. Expert estimates of the extent to which political leaders are elected under comprehensive voting rights in free and fair elections, and freedoms of association and expression are guaranteed. The index ranges from 0 to 1 (most democratic).

owid.vdem.libdem.label: Liberal democracy index
owid.vdem.libdem.subtitle: Data by V-Dem. Expert estimates of the extent of voting rights, the freedom and fairness of elections, freedoms of association and expression, civil liberties, and executive constraints. The index ranges from 0 to 1 (most democratic).

owid.vdem.rights.label: Human rights index
owid.vdem.rights.subtitle: Data by V-Dem. Expert estimates of the extent to which people are free from government torture, political killings, and forced labor, have property rights, and enjoy the freedoms of movement, religion, expression, and association. The index ranges from 0 to 1 (most rights).

owid.row.regime.label: Political regime (Regimes of the World)
owid.row.regime.subtitle: Classification by Lührmann et al. (2018) based on expert estimates by V-Dem.

owid.vdem.corruption.label: Political corruption index
owid.vdem.corruption.subtitle: Data by V-Dem. Expert estimates of the extent to which the executive, legislative, judiciary, and bureaucracy engage in bribery and theft, and the making and implementation of laws are susceptible to corruption. The index ranges from 0 to 1 (highly corrupt).

owid.vdem.ruleoflaw.label: Rule of law index
owid.vdem.ruleoflaw.subtitle: Data by V-Dem. Expert estimates of the extent to which the government complies with the law, courts are independent, laws transparent, justice accessible, corruption absent, and the bureaucracy is impartial. The index ranges from 0 to 1 (most rule-based).

owid.hanson.statecap.label: State capacity index
owid.hanson.statecap.citation: Jonathan Hanson and Rachel Sigman (2021); Population based on various sources (2023)
owid.hanson.statecap.subtitle: The index captures the extent to which the state controls its territory, sustainably raises sufficient resources, and has skilled and impartial security forces and public servants. Higher scores mean more capacity.

owid.co2.percapita.label: CO₂ emissions per capita
owid.co2.percapita.citation: Global Carbon Budget (2025); Population based on various sources (2024)

owid.wpb.prisonrate.label: Prison population rate
owid.wpb.prisonrate.citation: Institute for Crime & Justice Policy Research (2026); Population based on various sources (2024)
owid.wpb.prisonrate.subtitle: Number of prisoners, including pre-trial and remand detainees, per 100,000 people.

owid.wpb.occupancy.label: Prison occupancy level
owid.wpb.occupancy.citation: Institute for Crime & Justice Policy Research (2026)
owid.wpb.occupancy.subtitle: Occupancy level is measured relative to the country's stated official capacity. Values greater than 100% indicate that the number of prisoners exceeds the official capacity of prisons.
